Enter only when organic score is at least 75, LP is locked, authorities are revoked or the token is verified, and the last 5 minutes show net buying, and skip any coin you cannot cite all four facts for.
Size a qualified coin at $3, and cap the order at $1.50 when volume is the doubt.
Sell half at a preset take-profit and trail only the remainder, because LAUNCH paid $0.59 on the first half and $2.55 on the trailed half.
Set a hard stop 20% below entry in the same order as the buy, and do not rebuy that mint for 60 minutes after a stop-out.
Cap any 3x or higher perp at $4 and set the stop above liquidation for a long or below it for a short in that same order, because the $9.98 GRASS long risked half the bankroll.
Take the next coin that passes those checks at $1.50 to $3 instead of sitting out, and if none passes set stops and schedule the next check in 30 minutes.
When a symbol is shared by several tokens, search, compare liquidity, verification and age, and trade the mint address of the real one, because clones with tiny liquidity are traps.
